Running command: python3 - <<'PY'
import struct, subprocess, random, os, sys, time
BIN='/tmp/fribidi-fuzzer-asan'
chars=[0x61,0x62,0x5d0,0x627,0x31,0x20,0x28,0x29,0x5b,0x5d,0x7b,0x7d,0x2066,0x2067,0x2068,0x2069,0x202a,0x202b,0x202c,0x202d,0x202e,0x300,0xa,0x9]
weights=[5,5,5,3,3,3,8,8,4,4,3,3,10,10,5,12,2,2,2,2,2,2,1,1]
def test(seq, i):
    path='/tmp/poc.bin'
    open(path,'wb').write(b''.join(struct.pack('<I',x) for x in seq))
    p=subprocess.run([BIN,path],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=1)
    if p.returncode:
        print('CRASH iter',i,'len',len(seq),'rc',p.returncode,'seq',[hex(x) for x in seq])
        print(p.stderr.decode('latin1','ignore')[:4000])
        open('/workspace/crash.bin','wb').write(open(path,'rb').read())
        sys.exit(0)
# deterministic nested weird
for n in range(1,80):
    seq=[0x2066]*n+[0x2069]*n+[0x20]
    test(seq, -n)
    seq=[]
    for i in range(n): seq += [0x2066,0x28]
    seq += [0x2069]*n+[0x29]*n
    test(seq, -1000-n)
for i in range(20000):
    L=random.randint(1,80)
    seq=random.choices(chars, weights=weights, k=L)
    # often balanced-ish isolates/brackets
    if random.random()<0.3:
        k=random.randint(1,20)
        seq=[]
        for _ in range(k):
            seq += random.choice([[0x2066],[0x2067],[0x2068],[0x28],[0x61]])
            if random.random()<0.5: seq += [random.choice([0x20,0x61,0x5d0,0x28,0x29])]
        for _ in range(k):
            seq += [random.choice([0x2069,0x29,0x20])]
    test(seq,i)
print('no crash')
